pr_title: Command line apps use libctx and property query
pr_body:
In many places the command line application was not passing it's library context and property query to `XXX_fetch` and `XXX_do_all_provider`.  This addresses this oversight.

Also added a _-digest_ option to the SPKAC command.

Fixes  #15686 & #15683

- [x] documentation is added or updated
- [x] tests are added or updated

issue_context.title: apps are inconsistent about using a library context and property query
issue_context.body: When fetching algorithms, the various commands are inconsistent about using the app's library context and property query.

review_comments: Not sure this one is useful..
I don't think it changes anything either but it brings all uses into consistency.  We never know where the copy/paste source will be....
Hard to know when to use app_get0_propq() ?
That argument is a `CONF_METHOD *`, so no.  Still, there are a lot of calls where a propq could be passed and I've not searched for them all.
I real benefit would be if the implementation was moved from `apps/lib/apps.c` to `apps/lib/app_libctx.c` while you're doing this.

This wouldn't help.  `bio_err` would still be sucked in which pulls in apps.o

I don't remember the specifics of not wanting to `#include "apps.h"` in opt.c beyond knowing there was a reason.
Because it is used in the tests, not just the apps (and apps.h should not get pulled into tests)
